incident-bot: [ALERT] Service: inference-api region: us-west-2 — high 5xx rate detected (p99 latency spike). Pager routed to @Jordan (oncall) and @Tasha (SRE). See /incidents/bridge-2087654321

Jordan (oncall): ACK. Joining bridge now. see ingests spiking, getting error traces.

Tasha (SRE): I'm on it. Quick look at ingress shows a retry loop hitting the model pool, cache hit rate dropped — suspecting a KV eviction cascade.

Mike (Platform): Rolling deploy to a routing tweak just finished ~20m ago — could be related. No autoscaler changes.

Jordan (oncall): Customer reports: intermittent failures for chat endpoints. Support pings are starting to come in. Kevin, any major customer impact yet?

Kevin (Support): Notified a handful of mid-market customers. Most see degraded latency + 502s. No major outage tickets yet but on-call CS is prepping a bulletin.

Aisha (Eng): I see a pattern: a spike of long sequences causing token-cache thrash. Batching backlog also grew — requests queued and then timed out.

Tasha (SRE): Mitigation plan: 1) reduce batching window to force immediate flush, 2) spin up two extra model replicas in pool, 3) apply temporary rate-limit per-customer per-minute. Doing 1 and 2 now.

Jordan (oncall): Implemented batching window change (1). Increased pool (2). Early signs — p99 dropping but still some 502s.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment 2028.3.11 to inference-api completed by @Mike (Platform) — id=deploy-2087654315.

Mike (Platform): That deploy included a routing change to prefer smaller-sequence model variants for long requests. Might be a factor if rollout hit old instances.

Aisha (Eng): Can we pump logs for slow KV ops? I'm seeing KV timeouts at the same time as 502s.

Tasha (SRE): Enabled extra KV metrics and increased op timeout to reduce hard failures. Still watching.

Jordan (oncall): Oncall handoff note for next: if errors persist after mitigation, escalate to Platform — there may be a slow rollout edge-case.

Kevin (Support): Customer bulletin drafted: 'We are investigating intermittent HTTP 5xx errors affecting chat responses in us-west-2. Mitigation in progress.' Posting in 10m unless we fully clear.

Elaine (PM): Heads up: a small number of transactions failed during billing window. We should add to post-incident impact assessment.

Tasha (SRE): Good catch. I'll snapshot failure rates by product ID for postmortem.

Jordan (oncall): After spin-up + batching tune, error rate is down ~85%. Marking incident as contained.

incident-bot: [INCIDENT RESOLVED] Containment achieved at ~2087654560. Root cause still under investigation.

Aisha (Eng): Initial hypothesis: combination of routing rollout + long-sequence workload change caused cache eviction cascades, which increased tail latency; autoscaling lagged and batching amplified retries.

Tasha (SRE): Next steps — schedule a post-incident review. Proposed timeslot: 2087658000 (UTC) for a 60-minute blameless review. Who can make it?

Jordan (oncall): I can. I'll present timeline and oncall actions.

Mike (Platform): I'll attend and bring deploy logs and rollout state.

Elaine (PM): I'll join to cover customer impact and communications.

Kevin (Support): I'll bring customer logs and the bulletin timeline.

Aisha (Eng): I'll present KV metrics and batching traces.

Tasha (SRE): Agenda items: timeline, customer impact summary, root-cause hypotheses, immediate fixes, and medium-term remediation: alert tuning, SLO review, rollback logic for rollouts.

Jordan (oncall): Action items assigned during bridge:
- Jordan: compile timeline and incident timeline notes into confluence page (/kb/incidents/2087654321)
- Tasha: capture KV metric snapshots and finalize mitigation steps taken
- Mike: audit rollout window & canary rules; prepare a rollback checklist for routing changes
- Aisha: add deterministic test for long-sequence cache behavior to CI
- Kevin: track customer alerts and affected accounts list (for support followup)

Tasha (SRE): New monitoring/improvement proposals to discuss in review:
- Reduce noise: introduce dedupe rule for repeated per-request 502s within 30s to avoid pager storms
- SLO tweak: add a 'long-request' SLO bucket so long-sequence workloads don't skew global p99 SLOs
- Alert rewrite: split 5xx alerts into severity tiers: elevated p50/p95 vs tail p99+ correlated with KV timeouts
- Autoscaler: add a faster burst policy for sudden sequence-length shifts (short cool-up window)
- Rollout: autoblock routing rollouts if error rate delta > 2% over 5m

Mike (Platform): Agree on rollout autoblock. Also propose a small canary test that sends synthetic long-sequence traffic after any routing change.

Aisha (Eng): Action: I'll implement the synthetic long-sequence canary and a KV evict simulation in staging. ETA 3 days.

Jordan (oncall): For paging noise: create a suppression that groups repeated identical 502s by trace id for 5m, route only one pager with aggregated context. Tasha, can SRE own that rule?

Tasha (SRE): Yes, we'll own the suppression rule and add a dashboard for alert details so we don't lose signal.

Kevin (Support): On the customer side, I'll follow up with affected accounts, and offer postmortem summary once available.

Elaine (PM): Please add customer-facing impact summary to the confluence doc and include mitigation timeline + ETA for root-cause fix.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem meeting at 2087658000. Attendees: Jordan, Tasha, Mike, Aisha, Elaine, Kevin.

Jordan (oncall): Closing tasks for now: I will put the initial bridge notes in the doc and tag folks. If anyone finds ongoing regressions please reopen. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

Tasha (SRE): Adding follow-ups and owners to tracker: "2087654321-eviction-cascade" with subtasks for monitor changes, canary tests, SLO buckets, and rollout autoblock.

Aisha (Eng): I'll post a short runbook update for handling KV eviction spikes (quick mitigation steps) after postmortem.

Mike (Platform): After the review, let's plan a gradual deploy of the rollout autoblock and synthetic canary to staging next week.

Kevin (Support): I'll update customers once postmortem doc is live.

Jordan (oncall): Thanks everyone. Bridge closed.

incident-bot: Bridge closed by Jordan (oncall) at ~2087654680. This thread will be used for postmortem coordination and action tracking.
